common.loss: Soft cross-entropy plus soft Dice; binary real targets or synthetic area-coverage targets with validity masks.
common.augmentation: Paired native integer translations up to 25 pixels, rotations/flips, gamma/gain/offset changes and noise; original V46.2 sampler policy.
common.normalisation: Existing native cache with specimen-envelope 0.5th–99.5th percentile normalisation; GFRP adds local contrast channels at 9 and 31 pixels; other materials use a single channel.

statistics: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over all five independent seeds; no runs excluded.
fitting: 14 fitting images per material, with fixed nested 7- and 4-image subsets; identical subsets across seeds.
independence: Five independently initialised virtual models per material; each fine-tuning run starts from its own seed-matched virtual model.
generator: 35% original no-new-injection controls. Among positive examples: 80% original V45, 10% original geometry with extended grey rendering, 10% extended geometry with extended grey rendering. No fitting-label-selected real backgrounds in virtual pretraining.
validation: Same six real images per material select checkpoints; final full-native-image inference uses 256-pixel windows, 128-pixel stride, Hann overlap and threshold 0.5. Confusion counts are pooled across the six images before mIoU is computed.
scope: Development validation on correlated slices from the same acquisitions, not an independent test; total pretraining-plus-adaptation compute differs from real-only training.
schedule_change: Fine-tuning cap 260 epochs, versus 120 in the preceding comparison. This is not a generator-only causal ablation.
